valhalla_api_key.title: Valhalla API key
valhalla_api_key.description: API key from valhalla.nextron-systems.com. The default is the public demo key, which only grants the community feed. Stored as a secret: masked once the account is saved.

sekoia_api_key.title: Sekoia API key
sekoia_api_key.description: Bearer token from Sekoia (Settings → Workspace → API Keys). Used to push rules into the Sekoia Rules Catalog. Stored as a secret: masked once the account is saved.

sekoia_base_url.title: Sekoia API base URL
sekoia_base_url.description: Region-specific base URL. Default https://api.sekoia.io covers FRA1. For FRA2/MCO1/UAE1 use https://app.<region>.sekoia.io/api.

community_uuid.title: Sekoia community UUID
community_uuid.description: Optional. Only needed when the API key has access to several communities (e.g. MSSP keys): the sync then only reads and writes rules of this community. To find the UUID, open the community in Sekoia, go to Settings > General and copy the part of the URL between /communities/ and /community-details.

description: Nextron Valhalla is the rule feed of Nextron Systems, offering more than 24,000 YARA and more than 4,000 Sigma rules, curated and regularly updated by Nextron's threat researchers. This integration brings Valhalla's Sigma rules into the Sekoia Rules Catalog and keeps them up to date automatically, so new and improved detections reach your environment without manual work. You choose whether imported rules arrive enabled or disabled, so you stay in control of which detections run. Valhalla customers receive the full feed; without a subscription, the free community feed is available.
name: Nextron Valhalla
